# Support
This file explains how to get help and support with this project.

## Getting Help
- Check the project documentation and README first.
- Search for any existing issues to see if your question has already been answered.

## Reporting Problems
- If you encounter a problem, create a new issue following the issue template.
- Provide as much detail as possible, including steps to reproduce the problem and any relevant screenshots or logs.

## Contact
- Put in group-4 group chat if there is a major problem or if support is necessary.
